dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Welcome to Fengtai General Goods! Everyday items, commemorative jade jewelry... You name it, we stock it!

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Oh sure, of course! Take your pick!

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: That is right. We do have a build-to-order jadeware service, but it requires a reservation, and the time required is based on how complicated the design is.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: You don't choose a piece of jade, it chooses you. Chance encounters often make the best purchases.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: So it's not a bad thing if you don't find anything you like today...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why aren't there many jade artisans?

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Many guests have asked the same question, as did I when I was young.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Deyin, my master, told me that one must suffer no distraction when carving a piece of beautiful jade.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: If an artisan must also sell and promote, then their minds are invaded by such thoughts, and true excellence will elude their work.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: In Chenyu Vale, the sale and production of jade are completely separate. This allows our artisans to focus on carving.

dialogues.speaker: Fengtai
dialogues.text: Who knows, there might be an artisan sequestered within any given house you might pass by, meticulously shaping the jade in their hands.
